title: Answer: lawlike chances leave room for free will as a higher-level phenomenon

statements.text: Determinism or lawlike probabilistic behavior of self states is not a restriction on free will as a higher-level phenomenon. With Marius Krumm, Müller proposes computational sourcehood: predicting a process must typically involve an almost exact representation of it, so the process itself is the source of its actions.

sources.quote: not be seen as a restriction on the possibility of free will as a higher-level phenomenon
We argue that this can be understood as saying that the process itself is the source of its actions
